answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Sanctified vehicle inspector accreditation with vehicle inspectors attestation flips the bet — an accreditation inspectors renew after test audits — and the horizon lands on the attacker instead. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the ripple of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The echo grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
